title: contributor
description: One contributor key seen in a cycle: a unique normalized name, ZIP5, employer and occupation, the unit resolution links into donors. Partitioned by cycle, so a key seen in several cycles has a row in each: `contributor_key` is unique within a cycle's partition, not across them. The files hold no cycle column: read it from the partition.

contributor_key.description: The normalized name, ZIP5, employer and occupation joined by `|`.

donor_id.description: The resolved donor the key belongs to.

name_raw.description: The name as the key's chosen variant reports it. The variant is a whole set of reported name, city, state, ZIP, employer and occupation: the one most of the key's contributions in the cycle report, then the one with the most money, then the one most of its JFC attributions report.

name_first.description: The chosen variant's first name, normalized.

name_suffix.description: Its suffix (`JR`, `III` …), normalized; null for none.

employer_raw.description: The employer as the chosen variant reports it.

occupation_raw.description: The occupation as the chosen variant reports it.

contribution_count.description: The key's contributions in the cycle.

amount_total.description: Their amount in dollars, refunds netted.

attribution_count.description: The key's JFC attributions in the cycle: memo lines naming it behind a joint fundraising committee's transfer. Evidence, never money.
